evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and modifies CMake scripts (`cmake/module/CheckSourceCompilesWithFlags.cmake`, `cmake/introspection.cmake`).
rationale: Fixes CMake compiler check false-positives on warnings and resolves `clang-cl` rejection of `-msse4` for SHA-NI detection. It also serves as a prerequisite for #31507, but addresses a relatively minor compiler-compatibility edge case.
